title: ReadinessFix

anyOf.description: A slash command a person sends to fix the check, such as /setup-matt-pocock-skills: a / then the command's name, with any arguments, on one line.

A step of the milestone-1 checklist, registered or not, each with the label every client names it by: account (Account), carry-over (Carry over), your-machines (Your machines), forges (Forges), key-manager (Key manager), memory-bank (Memory bank), skills (Skills), instructions (Instructions), browser (Browser), permissions (Permissions), appearance (Appearance).

description: What fixes a failing check: a slash command to send (it starts with /), or the id of the Set up step that does (such as skills).
